job.description: Categorizes the message field per app_code: count by category and rare categories.

detectors.detector_description: Count of messages per category for each app_code
Rare message category for each app_code

ui_path: Observability > Machine learning > Anomaly detection > Jobs > Create job > data view 'App logs (workshop)' > Categorization. Categorization field message, detector Count, enable 'Per-partition categorization' with partition field app_code.keyword and 'Stop on warn'. Then add the Rare detector in the Advanced wizard. Bucket span 15m, job ID mlws-logs-categories, group mlws.
teaches: Per-partition categorization groups messages separately for each app_code. A5 adds a brand-new message type 'Catalog sync ... rejected: HTTP 422' (rare and high count in ABC) and A6 adds 'Inventory delta rejected' messages in DEF.
